name: Notifications
description: Sends Starboard's events to email, Telegram, Discord, Signal, Pushover, ntfy or a webhook, in plain words, and a weekly New this week.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Something someone asked for is ready
settings.hint: Reelix's or Seerr's requests that become ready to watch.

settings.label: Tell the person who asked too
settings.hint: By the email address or Telegram chat given for them under People.

settings.label: A download failed
settings.hint: A download that stops with a problem.

settings.label: An app stops answering, and when it is back
settings.hint: After two checks in a row with no answer.

settings.label: A disk is nearly full
settings.hint: At the limit set for alerts in Settings, Alerts, or 90%.

settings.label: An update is ready
settings.hint: For Starboard, your apps and your plug-ins.

settings.label: New this week
settings.hint: Films, series and more that arrived in the last 7 days, once a week at 09:00.

settings.label: Starboard's address, for links
settings.hint: Optional, such as http://192.0.2.10:8095. Messages end with Open Starboard and this address.

settings.label: Send by email
settings.hint: Activate once the details below are filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Email server
settings.hint: Such as smtp.example.com

settings.label: Password
settings.hint: An app password where your email service offers one.

settings.label: Send from
settings.hint: Such as starboard@example.com

settings.label: Send email to
settings.hint: One address a line.

settings.label: Send by Telegram
settings.hint: Activate once the details below are filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.hint: From @BotFather in Telegram.

settings.label: Telegram chat
settings.hint: One chat id a line. Send your bot a message first, so it may write to you.

settings.label: Send by Discord
settings.hint: Activate once the webhook is filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Discord webhook address
settings.hint: In Discord: the channel's Edit channel, Integrations, Webhooks, Copy webhook URL.

settings.label: Send by Signal
settings.hint: Only if you run signal-cli-rest-api, which sends for a number you registered with it.

settings.label: Send from number
settings.hint: The number registered with it, such as +447700900123.

settings.label: Send Signal messages to
settings.hint: One number or group id a line.

settings.label: Send by Pushover
settings.hint: Activate once the keys below are filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Application token
settings.hint: Make an application for Starboard on pushover.net.

settings.label: Send by ntfy
settings.hint: Activate once the topic is filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Topic
settings.hint: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic can read it, so make it hard to guess.

settings.label: Access token
settings.hint: Optional, for a server or topic that needs one.

settings.label: Send to webhooks
settings.hint: Activate once an address is filled in and the test arrives.

settings.label: Webhook addresses
settings.hint: One or more, separated by spaces. Each gets title, body and type as JSON, as the Apprise API's notify address takes them.

settings.label: People
settings.hint: One person a line: the name they use in Reelix or Seerr, a comma, then their email address or telegram and their chat id.

jobs.label: Send New this week on the chosen day

added: **Seven ways to send:** email, Telegram, Discord, Signal (through signal-cli-rest-api), Pushover, ntfy and Apprise-style webhooks, each with a Test button.
**What it sends:** a request ready to watch (to the person who asked too), a failed download, an app down and back, a disk nearly full, an update ready, and New this week.
Plain words with no meaning in symbols, and links with words before them.
Rests between messages: Starboard's events and its daily job wake it, so it uses no memory while idle.
